morphology.pattern_note: 若指英语专名 Fitz，通常为单音节，词尾 tz 读 /ts/。此处不把历史姓名成分 Fitz- 当作马来语词缀；尚无依据建立马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 可能为专名 Fitz，音译“菲茨”，可用作姓氏或昵称；缺少原始语境，尚不能确定输入项具体指谁或是否属于其他名称。
senses.en_definition: Possibly the proper name Fitz, used as a surname or nickname; the intended referent cannot be established without context.
senses.ms_definition: Kemungkinan nama khas Fitz, sama ada nama keluarga atau nama panggilan; rujukan sebenar tidak dapat dipastikan tanpa konteks asal.
senses.nuances: 这不是已核实的马来语普通词义。专名解释为暂定解释，IPA 也仅适用于该解释。正常行文写作 Fitz。以下搭配及对话为专名用法的教学拟例，未经频率验证。马来文释义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 原文。status 按指定模板保留为 official，不表示已获得词典收录或规范用词认证；排名仅沿用资料包。

etymology.historical_story: In medieval Anglo-Norman records, forms including fiz and fitz meant 'son' and appeared in expressions identifying parentage. This historical naming element helps explain familiar Fitz- surnames. It does not establish the identity or origin of this particular corpus token, which still requires its original sentence. [Source: Anglo-Norman Dictionary](https://anglo-norman.net/entry/fitz).
